en.headline: First local chikungunya case of 2026 confirmed in Tai Kok Tsui
en.dek: A 55-year-old woman living on Li Tak Street has tested positive; she had no recent travel history and is in stable condition in a mosquito-free ward.
body: Hong Kong has recorded its first locally acquired chikungunya fever case of 2026, the Centre for Health Protection said on Thursday. The patient is a 55-year-old woman who lives on Li Tak Street in Tai Kok Tsui. She is in stable condition and is receiving treatment in a mosquito-free environment at Queen Elizabeth Hospital.

She developed fever, headache and joint pain in her fingers and wrists on 7 September, followed by a rash on her face and body. She sought medical attention at the hospital on Wednesday. Blood tests confirmed infection with the chikungunya virus. Preliminary investigations found she had not travelled during the incubation period and spent most of her time at home, though she recalled being bitten by mosquitoes near her residence, Cherry Street Park and Lok Kwan Street Park.

One household contact has no symptoms and is under medical surveillance. The Centre for Health Protection is working with other departments on vector investigations and mosquito-control measures around the patient’s home. A hotline (2125 2373) has been set up for residents in the affected area who develop fever, rash or joint pain after 1 August to seek advice.

Hong Kong has now recorded three confirmed chikungunya cases this year — one local and two imported. The centre urged residents living or active near Li Tak Street, Cherry Street Park and Lok Kwan Street Park to take precautions against mosquito bites and to seek medical attention promptly if symptoms appear.

zh.headline: 本港今年首宗基孔肯雅熱本地個案 患者居大角咀利得街
zh.dek: 55歲女子無外遊紀錄，目前情況穩定，正於伊利沙伯醫院無蚊環境下接受治療。
body: 衞生防護中心周四公布，本港錄得今年首宗基孔肯雅熱本地感染個案。患者為一名居於大角咀利得街的55歲女子，目前情況穩定，正於伊利沙伯醫院無蚊環境下接受治療。
患者於本月7日出現發燒、頭痛，以及手指和手腕關節疼痛，其後面部及身體出現紅疹。她昨日到伊利沙伯醫院求醫，血液樣本經化驗後證實對基孔肯雅熱病毒呈陽性反應。初步調查顯示，患者於潛伏期內沒有外遊，大部分時間留在家中，記憶所及曾在住所、櫻桃街公園和樂群街公園一帶被蚊叮咬。
她的一名家居接觸者現時沒有病徵，中心正提供醫學監察。衞生防護中心正與相關部門採取跟進工作，包括在病人家居附近進行病媒調查和防蚊措施，並已設立熱線2125 2373，供上月1日起出現發燒、皮疹或關節痛症狀的市民查詢。
本港今年累計錄得三宗基孔肯雅熱確診個案，包括一宗本地個案及兩宗輸入個案。中心呼籲居於或活動於大角咀利得街、櫻桃街公園及樂群街公園附近一帶的市民，注意防蚊，並在出現相關症狀時盡快求醫。
